subject.title: feat(mobile): default pairing to full node access

question: After the Limited downgrade path is made exact and tested, should official iOS and Android setup codes grant operator.admin by default, or should bounded access remain the default with Full access explicitly selected?
rationale: Changing the default mobile bootstrap credential from bounded scopes to admin-equivalent authority is a product security policy choice; tests can prove implementation behavior but cannot determine the repository's intended least-privilege default.

options.title: Approve Full After Repair
options.body: Fix exact Limited downgrades, add bidirectional transition proof, and then accept full access as the official mobile default with explicit maintainer sign-off.

options.title: Keep Limited Default
options.body: Retain the current bounded default and expose Full access as an explicit operator-selected setup option.

options.title: Pause The Direction
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not land the authority change until mobile-controller trust and setup-code handling policy are documented more narrowly.

recommendation.title: Approve Full After Repair
recommendation.body: Fix exact Limited downgrades, add bidirectional transition proof, and then accept full access as the official mobile default with explicit maintainer sign-off.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available history across device-pair commands, gateway role enforcement, and the proposed cross-platform pairing behavior.
